Karnataka Bill to Bar RSS Events in Govt Buildings

The Karnataka government is reportedly preparing to introduce a new bill that would prohibit the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) from holding its programs in government buildings. This move follows a decision by the state government to disallow RSS events in these premises. The proposed legislation aims to formalize this restriction.
